question.prompt: Lines \(a\) and \(b\) are cut by line \(c\). Angles \(\angle 1\) and \(\angle 2\) are same-side interior angles, and \(\angle 1=75^\circ\). What must the measure of \(\angle 2\) be, in degrees, for \(a\parallel b\)?

solutions.explanation: If same-side interior angles are supplementary, the two lines are parallel, so \(\angle 2=180^\circ-75^\circ=105^\circ\).
solutions.title: Supplementary-angle criterion
